title: Flowgit community template registry
description: The merged community registry (https://flowgit.dev/registry.json): a JSON array. Each file in registry/community/<id>.json is one entry object with the same fields as $defs/entry; the old single-file array still reads. The checker is validateCommunityRegistry in packages/cli/src/registry.ts. 合并后的社区登记是一个 JSON 数组。registry/community/<id>.json 每个文件是一条，字段和 $defs/entry 一样；旧的单文件数组还能读。检查逻辑是 packages/cli/src/registry.ts 的 validateCommunityRegistry。

id.description: Stable id used as flowgit init -t <id>.

git.description: Git URL. A repository subdirectory is #path=<subdir>, for example https://github.com/org/repo.git#path=examples/agent-page.

ref.description: Optional branch or tag. Omit to use the repository default.

license.description: A clear license name, for example Apache-2.0 or MIT.
